modes.train: not run by default: collect stages run only when forced (configs/modes.json collect_kind_runs_only_when_forced) and every collected dataset is read from FF_DATA/01_collected (class 'collected' is in always_saved_classes). Re-collecting: force the whole collect closure in ONE run, with a fresh FF_WORK and FF_USE_SAVED=collected (README.md of 11_collect): FF_FORCE=c37_vox2,c53_vox2b,c46_voxblink,c45_frames_vox2,c_frames_index,c63_frames,c87_frames_bridge,c63v_audio_cache. Forcing this stage alone mixes its new rows with the old frames / audio cache (sampling is not deterministic).

env_note: FLAG_LOCAL / FLAG_SMOKE pinned to "0" so a value left in the caller's environment cannot switch the notebook into its local / smoke mode during a real run (smoke_env sets "1" under FF_SMOKE=1). FLAG_IN / FLAG_OUT would also bypass the runner's /kaggle paths if set by the caller and cannot be pinned here (a fixed value would be wrong): WP-A drops them from the inherited environment; never export them.

env_doc.AUDIO_TIME_LIMIT_H: default 10.5 (the original finished in about 7.4 h); outside Kaggle set it higher in the caller's environment, e.g. 48.
env_doc.AUDIO_RESUME_FROM: folder that CONTAINS the audio_cache/ of an earlier, time-limited run (resume patch). Unset = original behaviour.

run_policy: 13.54 ALWAYS uses the collected cache (skip_with): its key layout (bare `video` id, not spk/video) is exactly what makes the ORIGINAL LoRA C1 of RFS see only 210 MAV clips (no VoxCeleb2), so a 're-fixed' cache would change the 13.54 variant. 936 VoxCeleb2 clips are missing (85 351 wanted): the 117 VoxCeleb2 test speakers of FLAG_53 have audio only in vox2_test_aac.zip, which this notebook does not read (counts checked 18/11, G22).
notes: Upload: the code uploads only when AUDIO_UPLOAD is set; the runner unsets it (neutralize_upload), so no code change.
Old per-source LID rule (drop42 / drop53 / dropvb from each lid_summary.json); the strict list (lid_strict.json) is applied later by the consumers (t160b/c, t162b/c, t163l, t189).

No skip_with: the runner serves skip_with as a saved copy of the stage's KERNEL output, and no such copy exists (the FF_DATA/01_collected folders hold the exported datasets, which configs/data_map.json maps by their own ids). The stage is skipped by default because collect stages run only when forced.
Published dataset: 1 473 files (vb/ 690 npz, vox/ 779 npz, wire_{vb,vox,vox2b}.npz, audio_manifest.json at the root); the smallest wiring mean cosine is 0.99863 (vb, sam100pA).
post_checks make the notebook's own 'complete' flag fatal: a run stopped by AUDIO_TIME_LIMIT_H fails instead of being accepted.
